title: Wan Jie Xian Zong
synopsis:
Ye Xingyun's master ascended to immortality, leaving behind the powerful Tianyuan Divine Sect. Ye Xingyun became the new sect leader of the sect, and by swapping the prince for a prince, he became a disciple of a small noble family, hiding and waiting for a chance for revenge. Ye Xingyun embarked on an incredibly perilous path, but relying on his own strategy and the assistance of the Tianyuan Divine Sect's experts, he strategized and maneuvered to resist the vast Great Zhou Dynasty. 

(Sorce: Bangumi, translated)
